## About the Pudu Robotics KettyBot

The KettyBot combines delivery functionality with a large 18.5-inch advertising display, making it unique in the service robot category. Restaurants and retailers use KettyBot's screen to promote specials, upsell items, and run third-party ads — turning the robot into a revenue-generating asset beyond labor savings. At $11,900, it's Pudu's most cost-effective option for venues that want both delivery assistance and customer engagement.
